task_completion.description: Open CoppeliaSim and load the 'messaging/movementViaRemoteApi.ttt' scene.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CoppeliaSim GUI is visible with the specific scene name in the title bar or the scene hierarchy showing a robot arm.

task_completion.description: Add a Vision Sensor to the scene to observe the robot.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Vision_sensor' object is visible in the Scene Hierarchy tree on the left side of the CoppeliaSim interface.

task_completion.description: Write and execute a Python script using the ZMQ Remote API to control the robot.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An IDE or text editor (like VS Code or Mousepad) showing Python code importing 'coppelia_zmqremoteapi_client' and commanding random joint positions.

task_completion.description: Run the simulation for at least 50 steps with the robot moving to random positions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CoppeliaSim simulation is running (play button active) and the robot arm is seen in different poses across multiple screenshots.

task_completion.description: Save camera images to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer window showing the directory '/home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/images/' populated with multiple image files.

task_completion.description: Generate the rl_dataset.csv and dataset_metadata.json files with correct columns and fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing 'rl_dataset.csv' with headers (step_id, j0-j5, ee_x-z, image_filename) and 'dataset_metadata.json' with fields (total_samples, camera_resolution, robot_moved).

integrity.description: Verify the simulation was actually running during data collection.
integrity.visual_evidence: The simulation time counter in the CoppeliaSim toolbar is non-zero and changing between screenshots.

integrity.description: Ensure the CSV/JSON files were generated via script, not manually typed.
integrity.visual_evidence: The script execution in the terminal or IDE precedes the appearance of the files in the file explorer.

integrity.description: Check that the robot actually moved and wasn't just static.
integrity.visual_evidence: The joint values in the CSV or the visual pose of the robot in the 'images' folder vary significantly.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must generate at least 50 samples. The CSV must contain exactly these columns: step_id, j0, j1, j2, j3, j4, j5, ee_x, ee_y, ee_z, and image_filename. The metadata.json must include total_samples (>=50), camera_resolution (e.g., [512, 512]), and robot_moved (true). All files must be located in /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/.
